payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterative DP from right to left, maintaining max sums starting from each row at current index using O(1) state transition.
payload.rationale: The solution computes dp[i][row] = height[row][i] + max(dp[j][other_row] for j>i), optimized to O(n) by keeping best future values. State dimension is index, qualifying as dp_1d_state.
